notes.others: the other F-35Is in f-16.net's airframe database (docs/f35i.md §7, checked 19 Nov 2026), each squadron's in number order, all three at Nevatim: 116 Squadron's (the player's), then 140's (951 by its Commons photo; 921 also in IsraDecal's notes), then 117's, then the delivered jets whose squadron is open there. Not listed: the test centre's 924 at Tel Nof
notes.marks: where rig.py drew the number until 2026-11-19, in the low-visibility markings' pale grey (rig.py MARK_GREY; dark grey until 2026-11-25, docs/f35i.md §5.2): the whole number on each side of the nose (decals), and the whole number again low on each fin's outer face, just above the root and ahead of the rudder hinge as on 930 (quads: the fins are one surface seen from both sides; their outward normal measured on f35i.gltf, the fin canted 20 degrees; until 2026-11-25 the last two digits near the fin's tip) (docs/f35i.md §5.2, the photos)
